[[Category:Fuel cell]]
'''Grove's fuel cell''' is the first known functional [[fuel cell]].<ref>{{#cite:Q4257}}</ref>

== Setup ==

[[File:Grove's fuel cell.png|thumbnail|Schema of a modern recreation of Grove's fuel cell]]
A standard setup of a Grove's fuel cell is the same as the standard setup for [[electrolysis]] of water.

One important detail is that the electrodes must be made of '''[[platinum]]'''.

=== Charging ===

To charge a Grove's cell, one connect the two currents to an external source of electricity to electrolyse water and obtain oxygen and hydrogen gases.<ref>{{#cite:Q4257}}</ref>

{{#content:Q4264}}

=== Discharging ===

Once the external source of electricity is removed, the reverse reaction happens with Platinum as catalyst, producing an electric current.<ref>{{#cite:Q4257}}</ref>
